tasks.label: Sumurai: compile
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'out' | Out-Null; $sources = Get-ChildItem -Path 'src\com\sumurai' -Recurse -Filter '*.java' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & javac -encoding UTF-8 -d 'out' $sources; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
